acquisition.capture_policy: No source refetch. Reuse only the pinned completed EXP-084 capture snapshot. Preserve every original capture state including not acquired, errors, and refusals. Old stage time receives zero credit.
acquisition.input_source: The original 13 effective pools, corrective-search receipts, and source provenance, unchanged and hash-bound; plus EXP-084 completed capture snapshot, unchanged and hash-bound.
acquisition.pool_policy: All 13 task pools, native results, global card IDs, and source-ID mappings must be byte-equivalent to the EXP-084 snapshot; do not merge, trim, reorder, or supplement results.

adoption: No production adoption from this recovery. EXP-078 remains terminal inconclusive; separate untouched confirmation and full product delivery remain required.

candidate.contract: Exact EXP-076 canonical complete-pool dual Score populations and equal-weight Fraction RRF k60. Same query/purpose instructions, criteria, model, projection and tie rule; only fresh caller task/pool data differ.
candidate.phase_includes: fresh construction/serialization, exchange, parsing/fusion, final receipt fsync

capture.health: One read-only health request after new EXP-087 admission; parse the exact service shape {status: ok, runtime: {model, revision}}, require model free and revision matching the pinned EXP-084 health identity, and retain only nonsecret identity fields. Failure is terminal.
capture.raw_content_publication: private evidence storage; public sanitized hashes/aggregates only
capture.source_snapshot: Reuse the complete pinned EXP-084 capture subtree and its 442-source inventory; do not dispatch source HTTP requests or rewrite any captured bytes. Use the same bounded source contexts and source availability states.

card_reference_ids.catalog: For each frozen card, partition title/url/snippet independently in field order into consecutive non-overlapping Python-Unicode-code-point windows. Greedily extend each window while its UTF-8 encoding stays at or below 256 bytes; empty fields have no windows. Preserve every field character exactly once.
card_reference_ids.closure: Pin card-reference-id-adapter.py.txt, card-assessor-prompt.txt, and the assessment-input preparation frontend and tests in the EXP-087 qualified source closure before any reference calls.
card_reference_ids.failure: Unknown, cross-card, malformed, or unhydratable IDs, duplicate catalog IDs, duplicate facets/cards, or incomplete card/facet coverage remain invalid and terminal. Repeated IDs that each resolve within the same card are accepted and expanded once per occurrence in emitted order; no model response is repaired or deduplicated.
card_reference_ids.granularity: A selected ID hydrates to its complete deterministic window, not a model-selected subspan. Windows may include adjacent text; that bounded citation granularity is disclosed and is not a new content judgment.
card_reference_ids.hydration: Only known IDs assigned to the exact card and field are accepted. Hydration deterministically expands each ID to the legacy `{field, quote}` form and runs the unchanged exact-substring/byte-limit validator. No model-authored quote, field, offsets, or cross-card references.
card_reference_ids.id_derivation: IDs use the frozen exp077-card-reference-id/1 domain and bind task ID, card SHA-256, field name, window index and window-text SHA-256. Exact catalog entries also bind Unicode start/end and UTF-8 text hash.
card_reference_ids.input_presentation: The model receives the unchanged full original card fields plus the deterministic per-card window catalog. Both assessors receive the identical presentation and same finite IDs. This duplication/windowing is a prospective presentation change; do not compare grades directly to EXP-084.
card_reference_ids.output_shape: Keep the frozen EXP-077 arrays and item schema exactly: no uniqueItems constraint for anchors or facet_anchors. Repeated known same-card evidence_id values are valid array entries and hydrate to repeated legacy {field, quote} objects in exactly the same order. All other frozen checks remain unchanged.
card_reference_ids.purpose: Mechanical transport for the unchanged exact same-card anchor requirement.
card_reference_ids.semantic_scope: Does not alter lead/visible axes, facet definitions, scoring anchors, rubric, or thresholds. Window presentation is a prospective measurement change; preserve full original fields and present the same catalog to A and B.

confirmation_scope.wikipedia: excluded prospectively as unavailable; future three-engine confirmation is not comparable to earlier four-engine studies

consumer.alias_limitations: record configured and returned model identity; do not assert immutable checkpoint equivalence
consumer.source_availability_and_ordering: apply same dedup/refusal/video/availability policy to each fixed top-ten order; preserve failed openings separately

duplicate_reference_policy.allowed: Repeated known IDs bound to the same card and field, in anchors or a facet_anchors list; expand every occurrence in original order.
duplicate_reference_policy.change: Mechanical validator alignment only: remove the EXP-086-only duplicate-reference-ID rejection.

fresh_stage_scope.reuse_does_not_reset_or_extend_clock: Only the newly admitted EXP-087 stage receives a clock; reused EXP-084 acquisition and capture time receive zero credit.
fresh_stage_scope.starts_before: the single candidate health request and first model/reference work

grading_order: verify EXP-084 terminal packet and exact frozen input/snapshot hashes; exclude all EXP-084 grader outputs
perform source and CLI preflight, then create and consume the new EXP-087 admission and clock
perform at most one read-only candidate health check; stop on failure
mechanically prepare frozen card anchor-ID catalogs from the unchanged original visible card fields; freeze catalog bytes before references
obtain independent A/B card references and mechanically hydrate IDs; any incomplete/invalid grade stops with no retry or repair
prepare independent source references from the same captured contexts and unchanged source-assessment task
generate fixed-budget answers and independent assessments
verify receipts and calculate all unchanged frozen endpoints

input_provenance.old_stage_clock: Provenance only. Never accept it as EXP-087 clock, admission, lease, or elapsed-time credit.
input_provenance.required_paths_source: Exactly the files enumerated in reuse-input-pins.json; no grader-output paths.
input_provenance.source: The 13 original EXP-082 frozen input files plus the complete EXP-084 effective-input-envelope, old stage clock as provenance, capture subtree and terminal reference. EXP-084 card/source/answer grading outputs are excluded.

jev_invocation.call_slots: neutral capacity pair plus 13 base and 8 repeat/rotate operation pairs

models.answer_calls_basis: 16 task/arm answers plus 2 declared neutral readiness checks
models.answer_provider_surface: Existing process-configured OpenAI-compatible provider; secrets and endpoint values stay in memory and out of public artifacts.
models.card_and_source_and_answer_assessors: GPT-6 Luna, independent anonymous packets; not human gold. EXP-084 grader outputs are never reused.
models.reported_usage: retain where exposed; in-app grader billing/tokens may be unobservable, never invent them

phase_plan.assessment-preparation: Local deterministic preparation from the pinned EXP-084 snapshot; writes only beneath the new EXP-087 admitted stage and requires its phase permit.
phase_plan.card-reference: Fresh independent card-reference judgments using the EXP-087 evidence-ID packet; no EXP-084 grades are reused.
phase_plan.source-reference: Fresh independent source judgments over the same bounded contexts and source availability states; no source HTTP requests.

predecessor.failure: The first four card calls completed; the fifth response had a repeated known same-card reference ID. EXP-086 added a duplicate-reference rejection that is absent from the frozen EXP-077 output schema and verifier. Preserve its terminal outcome and exclude all old grader outputs from new inputs and reference truth.
predecessor.relation: New independently qualified development stage; no resumption, grade repair, or quality credit for EXP-086.
predecessor.reuse: The exact same 381 frozen input files and deterministic card-reference catalog are reused. All card and source assessments are generated fresh.

purpose: Prospective acceptance-shape alignment after EXP-086 stopped on a repeated known same-card reference ID. Reuse the exact same frozen inputs, catalog, candidate, prompts, rubrics, gates, budgets, cohorts, and confirmation plan. Preserve every emitted known same-card reference occurrence and its order during deterministic hydration to the unchanged EXP-077 legacy shape; do not deduplicate. All assessments are fresh. EXP-086 remains terminal.

recovery_runtime.health_request: One post-admission health request; accept only HTTP 200, status ok, runtime.model free, and runtime.revision equal to pinned EXP-084 health identity. No retry or source/model activity follows failure.
recovery_runtime.private_binding: Root-owned private salted configuration receipt binds the exact per-process runtime config. Never place URL, key, user profile, or raw config values in public protocol, source, logs, or receipts.
recovery_runtime.purpose: One mechanical adapter alignment: preserve repeated occurrences of valid known same-card evidence IDs in emitted order during hydration, matching the frozen EXP-077 schema/verifier behavior. Unknown or cross-card IDs and other structural errors remain invalid. All grader outputs are fresh; scientific inputs, prompts, candidate, and gates remain unchanged.

stop: Any source/input/config integrity failure, health failure, unregistered request, budget/deadline breach, missing required endpoint, incomplete grade, unknown evidence ID, or invalid hydrated anchor stops the new stage with retained partial evidence; no retries, searches, rescue, tuning, replacement, imputation, grade repair, or automatic confirmation.

task_use.assessor_disagreements: separate endpoints, never average into a pass
task_use.completion: all declared critical checks supported, applicable and correctly applied to delivered evidence; model self-certification is insufficient
task_use.source_unavailability: recorded in denominators; not-acquired is an observed state, not automatically a structural packet error
task_use.uncertainty_report: Paired task bootstrap of completion-count difference, 10000 draws, seed7701; descriptive only, no additional significance gate.

wire_types.authority_boundary: Preserve exp078-stage-clock/1 and EXP-078 payload schemas only as portable data types for frozen selector/answer helpers. Mint new EXP-087 stage ID and bind it to EXP-087 registration, qualification, manifest, inputs, and lease. Never accept any earlier stage clock, capability, permit, or lease as EXP-087 authority.
wire_types.card_reference_ids: New EXP-087-only card assessor output schema; do not reinterpret EXP-084 free-quote grader outputs.
wire_types.portable_reuse: EXP-078 effective acquisition, card, selector, and receipt structures are immutable input/wire types only.
